shloka_text: हते तु लवणे देवाः सेन्द्राः साग्निपुरोगमाः । ऊचुः सुमधुरां वाणीं शत्रुघ्नं शत्रुतापनम् ।। 7.70.1 ।।
transliteration: hate tu lavaṇe devāḥ sendrāḥ sāgnipurogamāḥ | ūcuḥ sumadhurāṃ vāṇīṃ śatrughnaṃ śatrutāpanam || 7.70.1 ||
translation: हते having been killed, तु indeed, लवणे Lavana, देवाः the gods, सेन्द्राः with Indra, साग्निपुरोगमाः with Agni at their forefront, ऊचुः spoke, सुमधुराम् very sweet, वाणीम् words, शत्रुघ्नम् to Shatrughna, शत्रुतापनम् the tormentor of enemies.
explanation: Indeed, after Lavana was killed, the gods, led by Indra and with Agni at their forefront, spoke very sweet words to Shatrughna, the tormentor of enemies.
comments: The gods offer Shatrughna a boon, and he asks that Madhu's realm become a populous city -- granting it, they depart, and Shatrughna founds the prosperous city of Mathura in Shurasena, adorning it over the years -- his purpose accomplished, he resolves to go and behold Rama when the twelfth year arrives.

shloka_text: दिष्ट्या ते विजयो वत्स दिष्ट्या लवणराक्षसः । हतः पुरुषशार्दूल वरं वरय सुव्रत ।। 7.70.2 ।।
transliteration: diṣṭyā te vijayo vatsa diṣṭyā lavaṇarākṣasaḥ | hataḥ puruṣaśārdūla varaṃ varaya suvrata || 7.70.2 ||
translation: दिष्ट्या fortunately, ते your, विजयो victory, वत्स O dear one, दिष्ट्या fortunately, लवणराक्षसः the demon Lavana, हतः is killed, पुरुषशार्दूल O tiger among men, वरं a boon, वरय ask for, सुव्रत O virtuous one.
explanation: O dear and virtuous tiger among men, it is by good fortune that you have achieved victory and the demon Lavana has been killed; now, ask for a boon.

shloka_text: वरदास्तु महाबाहो सर्व एव समागताः । विजयाकाङ्क्षिणस्तुभ्यममोघं दर्शनं हि नः ।। 7.70.3 ।।
transliteration: varadāstu mahābāho sarva eva samāgatāḥ | vijayākāṅkṣiṇastubhyamamoghaṃ darśanaṃ hi naḥ || 7.70.3 ||
translation: वरदास्तु indeed givers of boons, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, सर्व all, एव indeed, समागताः have assembled, विजयाकाङ्क्षिणस्तुभ्यम् desiring victory for you, अमोघं fruitful, दर्शनं sight, हि indeed, नः our.
explanation: O mighty-armed one, all of us who have assembled here are indeed givers of boons, having desired your victory, and our presence here is certainly not in vain.

shloka_text: देवानां भाषितं श्रुत्वा शूरो मूर्ध्नि कृताञ्जलिः । प्रत्युवाच महाबाहुः शत्रुघ्नः प्रयतात्मवान् ।। 7.70.4 ।।
transliteration: devānāṃ bhāṣitaṃ śrutvā śūro mūrdhni kṛtāñjaliḥ | pratyuvāca mahābāhuḥ śatrughnaḥ prayatātmavān || 7.70.4 ||
translation: देवानां of the gods, भाषितं speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, शूरो the brave one, मूर्ध्नि on his head, कृताञ्जलिः having made an anjali, प्रत्युवाच replied, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, प्रयतात्मवान् the self-controlled one.
explanation: Having heard the words of the gods, the brave, mighty-armed, and self-controlled Shatrughna, with folded hands placed on his head, replied.

shloka_text: इयं मधुपुरी रस्या मधुरा देवनिर्मिता । निवेशं प्राप्नुयाच्छीघ्रमेष मे ऽस्तु वरः परः ।। 7.70.5 ।।
transliteration: iyaṃ madhupurī rasyā madhurā devanirmitā | niveśaṃ prāpnuyācchīghrameṣa me 'stu varaḥ paraḥ || 7.70.5 ||
translation: इयं this, मधुपुरी the city of Madhu, रस्या delightful, मधुरा sweet, देवनिर्मिता created by gods, निवेशं a settlement, प्राप्नुयात् may obtain, शीघ्रम् quickly, एष this, मे my, अस्तु may be, वरः boon, परः supreme.
explanation: Shatrughna requested that this delightful and sweet city of Madhu, which was created by the gods, quickly become a populated settlement, declaring this to be his foremost boon.

shloka_text: तं देवाः प्रीतमनसो बाढमित्येव राघवम् । भविष्यति पुरी रम्या शूरसेना न संशयः ।। 7.70.6 ।।
transliteration: taṃ devāḥ prītamanaso bāḍhamityeva rāghavam | bhaviṣyati purī ramyā śūrasenā na saṃśayaḥ || 7.70.6 ||
translation: तं to him, देवाः the gods, प्रीतमनसो with pleased minds, बाढम् So be it, इति thus, एव indeed, राघवम् to the descendant of Raghu, भविष्यति will be, पुरी city, रम्या beautiful, शूरसेना Shurasena, न no, संशयः doubt.
explanation: With pleased minds, the gods replied to Shatrughna, the descendant of Raghu, saying "So be it," and assured him that the city would indeed become a beautiful one in the region of Shurasena, without a doubt.

shloka_text: ते तथोक्त्वा महात्मानो दिवमारुरुहुस्तदा । शत्रुघ्नो ऽपि महातेजास्तां सेनां समुपानयत् ।। 7.70.7 ।।
transliteration: te tathoktvā mahātmāno divamāruruhustadā | śatrughno 'pi mahātejāstāṃ senāṃ samupānayat || 7.70.7 ||
translation: ते they, तथा thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, महात्मानो the great souls, दिवम् to the sky/heaven, आरुरुहुः ascended, तदा then, शत्रुघ्नो Shatrughna, अपि also, महातेजाः highly effulgent/very powerful, तां that, सेनां army, समुपानयत् brought together/led
explanation: After the great sages spoke, they ascended to the heavens, and then the powerful Shatrughna gathered that army.

shloka_text: सा सेना शीघ्रमागच्छच्छ्रुत्वा शत्रुघ्नशासनम् । निवेशनं च शत्रुघ्नः श्रावणेन समारभत् ।। 7.70.8 ।।
transliteration: sā senā śīghramāgacchacchrutvā śatrughnaśāsanam | niveśanaṃ ca śatrughnaḥ śrāvaṇena samārabhat || 7.70.8 ||
translation: सा that, सेना army, शीघ्रम् quickly, आगच्छत् came, श्रुत्वा having heard, शत्रुघ्नशासनम् Shatrughna's command, निवेशनं the establishment/settlement (of the city), च and, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, श्रावणेन in the month of Shravana, समारभत् began
explanation: That army quickly arrived upon hearing Shatrughna's command, and Shatrughna began the establishment of the city in the month of Shravana.

shloka_text: सा पुरा दिव्यसङ्काशा वर्षे द्वादशमे शुभे । निविष्टा शूरसेनानां विषयश्चाकुतोभयः ।। 7.70.9 ।।
transliteration: sā purā divyasaṅkāśā varṣe dvādaśame śubhe | niviṣṭā śūrasenānāṃ viṣayaścākutobhayaḥ || 7.70.9 ||
translation: सा that (city), पुरा city, दिव्यसङ्काशा resembling a divine city, वर्षे in the year, द्वादशमे twelfth, शुभे auspicious, निविष्टा established/settled, शूरसेनानां of the brave warriors (or the region of Shurasena), विषयः region/country, च and, अकुतोभयः free from all fear
explanation: That city, resembling a divine abode, was established in the auspicious twelfth year, becoming a region for brave warriors, free from all fear.

shloka_text: क्षेत्राणि सस्ययुक्तानि काले वर्षति वासवः । अरोगवीरपुरुषा शत्रुघ्नभुजपालिता ।। 7.70.10 ।।
transliteration: kṣetrāṇi sasyayuktāni kāle varṣati vāsavaḥ | arogavīrapuruṣā śatrughnabhujapālitā || 7.70.10 ||
translation: क्षेत्राणि fields, सस्ययुक्तानि full of crops, काले at the proper time, वर्षति rains, वासवः Indra (the rain god), अरोगवीरपुरुषा having healthy and brave men, शत्रुघ्नभुजपालिता protected by Shatrughna's arm
explanation: The fields were full of crops, Indra rained at the proper time, and the region, protected by Shatrughna's arm, had healthy and brave men.

shloka_text: अर्धचन्द्रप्रतीकाशा यमुनातीरशोभिता । शोभिता गृहमुख्यैश्च चत्वरापणवीथिकैः । चातुर्वर्ण्यसमायुक्ता नानावाणिज्यशोभिता ।। 7.70.11 ।।
transliteration: ardhacandrapratīkāśā yamunātīraśobhitā | śobhitā gṛhamukhyaiśca catvarāpaṇavīthikaiḥ | cāturvarṇyasamāyuktā nānāvāṇijyaśobhitā || 7.70.11 ||
translation: अर्धचन्द्रप्रतीकाशा resembling a half-moon, यमुनातीरशोभिता adorned by the banks of Yamuna, शोभिता adorned, गृहमुख्यैः by prominent houses, च and, चत्वरापणवीथिकैः by squares, shops, and streets, चातुर्वर्ण्यसमायुक्ता endowed with the four varnas (social classes), नानावाणिज्यशोभिता adorned with various trades/commerce
explanation: The city, resembling a half-moon and beautified by the Yamuna's banks, was adorned with grand houses, squares, shops, and streets, inhabited by people of all four varnas, and bustling with diverse commerce.

shloka_text: यच्च तेन पुरा शुभ्रं लवणेन कृतं महत् । तच्छोभयति शत्रुघ्नो नानावर्णोपशोभिताम् ।। 7.70.12 ।।
transliteration: yacca tena purā śubhraṃ lavaṇena kṛtaṃ mahat | tacchobhayati śatrughno nānāvarṇopaśobhitām || 7.70.12 ||
translation: यच्च and which, तेन by him, पुरा formerly, शुभ्रं pure, लवणेन by Lavana, कृतं made, महत् great, तत् that, शोभयति beautifies, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, नानावर्णोपशोभिताम् adorned with various colors.
explanation: Shatrughna now beautifies that great and pure city, which was formerly created by Lavana, adorning it with various colors.

shloka_text: आरामैश्च विहारैश्च शोभमानं समन्ततः । शोभितां शोभनीयैश्च तथा ऽन्यैर्दैवमानुषैः ।। 7.70.13 ।।
transliteration: ārāmaiśca vihāraiśca śobhamānaṃ samantataḥ | śobhitāṃ śobhanīyaiśca tathā 'nyairdaivamānuṣaiḥ || 7.70.13 ||
translation: आरामैः with gardens, च and, विहारैः with pleasure-grounds, च and, शोभमानं shining, समन्ततः all around, शोभितां adorned, शोभनीयैः with beautiful things, च and, तथा similarly, अन्यैः with others, दैवमानुषैः divine and human.
explanation: The city was adorned all around with gardens and pleasure-grounds, and beautified by other divine and human elements.

shloka_text: तां पुरीं दिव्यसङ्काशां नानापण्योपशोभिताम् । नानादेशागतैश्चापि वणिग्भिरुपशोभिताम् ।। 7.70.14 ।।
transliteration: tāṃ purīṃ divyasaṅkāśāṃ nānāpaṇyopaśobhitām | nānādeśāgataiścāpi vaṇigbhirupaśobhitām || 7.70.14 ||
translation: तां that, पुरीं city, दिव्यसङ्काशां resembling a divine city, नानापण्योपशोभिताम् adorned with various merchandise, नानादेशागतैः arrived from various countries, च and, अपि also, वणिग्भिः by merchants, उपशोभिताम् adorned.
explanation: That city, resembling a divine abode, was adorned with various merchandise and beautified by merchants who had arrived from diverse lands.

shloka_text: तां समृद्धां समृद्धार्थः शत्रुघ्नो भरतानुजः । निरीक्ष्य परमप्रीतः परं हर्षमुपागमत् ।। 7.70.15 ।।
transliteration: tāṃ samṛddhāṃ samṛddhārthaḥ śatrughno bharatānujaḥ | nirīkṣya paramaprītaḥ paraṃ harṣamupāgamat || 7.70.15 ||
translation: तां that, समृद्धां prosperous, समृद्धार्थः one whose purpose is fulfilled, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, भरतानुजः younger brother of Bharata, निरीक्ष्य having seen, परमप्रीतः extremely pleased, परं great, हर्षं joy, उपागमत् attained.
explanation: Shatrughna, the younger brother of Bharata, whose purpose was fulfilled, observed that prosperous city and attained supreme joy, being extremely pleased.

shloka_text: तस्य बुद्धिः समुत्पन्ना निवेश्य मधुरां पुरीम् । रामपादौ निरीक्षे ऽहं वर्षे द्वादश आगते ।। 7.70.16 ।।
transliteration: tasya buddhiḥ samutpannā niveśya madhurāṃ purīm | rāmapādau nirīkṣe 'haṃ varṣe dvādaśa āgate || 7.70.16 ||
translation: तस्य his, बुद्धिः thought, समुत्पन्ना arose, निवेश्य having established, मधुरां Mathura, पुरीम् city, रामपादौ Rama's feet, निरीक्षे I shall see, अहं I, वर्षे in the year, द्वादश twelfth, आगते having arrived.
explanation: A thought arose in his mind that after establishing the city of Mathura, he would go to see Rama's feet when the twelfth year arrived.

shloka_text: ततः स ताममरपुरोपमां पुरीं निवेश्य वै विविधजनाभिसंवृताम् । नराधिपो रघुपतिपाददर्शने दधे मतिं रघुकुलवंशवर्धनः ।। 7.70.17 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ sa tāmamarapuropamāṃ purīṃ niveśya vai vividhajanābhisaṃvṛtām | narādhipo raghupatipādadarśane dadhe matiṃ raghukulavaṃśavardhanaḥ || 7.70.17 ||
translation: ततः then, सः he, ताम् that, अमरपुरोपमाम् resembling the city of gods, पुरीम् city, निवेश्य having established, वै indeed, विविधजनाभिसंवृताम् filled with various people, नराधिपः the king, रघुपतिपाददर्शने in seeing the feet of Rama, दधे placed, मतिम् mind, रघुकुलवंशवर्धनः the enhancer of the Raghu family lineage.
explanation: After establishing that city, which resembled the city of gods and was filled with various people, the king Shatrughna, the enhancer of the Raghu lineage, set his mind on seeing the feet of Lord Rama. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे सप्ततितमः सर्गः ।। 70 ।। Thus ends the seventieth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
